settings.label: Discord webhook for health reports
settings.help: Where the node posts its health report, covering both networks. In Discord: the channel's settings, Integrations, Webhooks, New Webhook, Copy Webhook URL. Leave empty for no reports.

settings.label: Check every (minutes)
settings.help: How often the node checks its health and, in the full-report mode, posts. At least 15.

choices.label: A full report at every check
Only problems, when they clear, and a daily summary

settings.label: Mention on a problem
settings.help: Who Discord notifies when a report shows a problem: a role (<@&role ID>), a person (<@user ID>), @here, or @everyone. Leave empty for no mention.

settings.label: Source code of the node you run
settings.help: Meadow is AGPL-3.0: if you run a modified node, point this at your modified source. Leave as it is for an unmodified node.
